fact: Law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 (art. 27) bars any decision producing legal effects from resting solely on automated processing of personal data to profile a person, and (art. 55) creates the IPDCP as the independent authority supervising it.
title: Loi n° 2019-014 du 29 octobre 2019 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
publisher: Journal Officiel de la République Togolaise
